step2.businessDescription: NXTFACE is an Indian skincare brand focused on younger consumers transitioning from adolescence into adulthood. It combines science-backed skincare formulations with an AI-powered skin analysis and product-recommendation experience. The brand sells affordable, cruelty-free skincare products through its own website, ecommerce marketplaces, retail outlets, pharmacies and the Naturals Salon network.
step2.productCategory: AI-assisted skincare and personal-care products for Gen Z and young adults
productsServices: Facial serums for hydration, brightening, oil control, pigmentation and skin renewal
Gel, mineral, spray, stick and tinted sunscreens for different skin types and usage occasions
Face washes, day creams and overnight sleeping masks
AI-powered skin analysis and personalised product recommendations
Skincare routines and product bundles designed for specific skin concerns

step3.primaryTargetSegment: Gen Z and young adults in Indian markets seeking affordable, simple, science-led skincare for Indian climates and diverse skin tones.
step3.targetPersona: A skincare-conscious consumer aged approximately 18 to 30 who discovers products through social media, creators, ecommerce platforms or salons, wants visible results without a complicated routine, compares ingredients and reviews before purchasing, and prefers accessible products tailored to individual skin concerns.
painPoints: Young consumers find skincare confusing because brands offer complex routines, technical ingredient claims and too many similar product choices.
Changing hormones, stress, pollution, sun exposure and different Indian climates can cause concerns such as acne, excess oil, dryness, pigmentation and uneven skin tone.
Consumers struggle to identify affordable products that suit their individual skin type and concerns without relying on trial and error.
step3.desiredOutcome: Help young Indian consumers understand their skin, select an appropriate and manageable skincare routine, address specific concerns and achieve healthier-looking skin through affordable, personalised and easy-to-use products.
step3.decisionProcess: The consumer becomes aware of NXTFACE through social media, an influencer, ecommerce discovery, advertising, a Naturals Salon visit or a recommendation. They identify a skin concern, use the AI skin analyser or review relevant products, compare ingredients, claims, ratings and prices, and then purchase through the brand website, an ecommerce marketplace or a physical retail location.
buyerRoles: Parent or family purchaser for a younger user
Beauty creator or salon professional influencing the purchase

trustSignals: NXTFACE was launched by Dhamyanthi Kumaravel from the family behind Naturals Salon, giving the brand access to an established Indian beauty-services network.
The product formulations were developed with support from Connell R&D, an established cosmetic ingredient and formulation organisation.
NXTFACE states that its products are cruelty-free and formulated without parabens, sulphates and toxins.
The official store publishes customer ratings and reviews across products such as sunscreens, serums, face washes and creams.
The brand offers an AI-powered skin-analysis experience intended to help consumers understand their skin and identify relevant products.
NXTFACE is distributed through its website and is positioned for availability through ecommerce, modern retail, pharmacies and more than 800 Naturals Salon locations.
